item.title: Uses
item.description:
This is a list of the tools and software I rely on for my mathematics research, teaching, and web development.

Hardware

  • Laptop: Linux Machine
  • Peripherals: Mechanical Keyboard (for those long LaTeX sessions)

Software & Tools

Editor & Terminal

  • Editor: VS Code
    • Theme: Default Dark / One Dark Pro
    • Extensions: LaTeX Workshop, Hugo Language Helper, Python
  • Terminal: Zsh
  • Version Control: Git & GitHub

Mathematics & Research

  • Typesetting: LaTeX (TeX Live)
  • Computation: Python (NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, SymPy) -> See my MCT Course

Website

  • Generator: Hugo (Static Site Generator)
  • Hosting: GitHub Pages
  • Design: Custom minimal Hugo templates (no theme), one CSS file

Teaching

  • Presentation: Beamer (LaTeX)
  • Notes: Markdown & LaTeX

item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hello and welcome to my website! My name is Yahia Djemmada, and I’m a lecturer at the National Higher School of Mathematics (NHSM) in Algiers, Algeria.

I’ve always been passionate about mathematics and computer sciences, and have pursued this interest through my education and career. I obtained my PhD degree in mathematics at University Of Science And Technology Houari Boumediene (USTHB).

In addition to my work as a lecturer, I’m also an active researcher in the fields of combinatorics and discrete mathematics, and have published some papers on these topics.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.description:
Last updated: 2026-07-26

Product: DZ Journal Check
Publisher: Yahia Djemmada
Contact: yahia.djem@gmail.com

Summary

DZ Journal Check is an independent Chrome extension that checks journal names, ISSNs, E-ISSNs, and DOI metadata against a bundled local DGRSDT/MESRS journal classification database.

The extension is designed for local journal classification on Google Scholar. It does not collect browsing history, Google Scholar searches, author names, article titles, account data, authentication information, financial information, health information, personal communications, or personally identifiable information.

item.title: Research
item.description:
I work in enumerative and analytic combinatorics. Most of my papers study special sequences and polynomials (Stirling, Bell, Fubini and geometric polynomials), set partitions and permutations, and the generating functions behind them. Where I can, I prove identities with combinatorial arguments.

The list below is kept up to date by hand. For citation counts, see my Google Scholar profile.

item.title: Support
item.description:
Use the email template below to send a support request directly to yahia.djem@gmail.com.

Open Support Email Template

DZ Journal Check is independent and unofficial. Please do not send passwords, authentication codes, cookies, private Google Scholar account details, or private profile information.

Before Reporting A Problem

  • Confirm that DZ Journal Check is enabled in Chrome.
  • Confirm you are using the latest extension version.
  • Try searching by ISSN, E-ISSN, or DOI when a title match is unclear.
  • Check whether Google Scholar is showing a journal venue, repository copy, arXiv preprint, book, thesis, or incomplete metadata.
  • Refresh the page once if Google Scholar dynamically loaded results after the extension started.

What The Email Template Includes

  • Chrome version.
  • DZ Journal Check extension version.
  • Operating system.
  • Page URL where the problem occurred, if it does not expose private information.
  • Search query or public result URL.
  • Journal title.
  • Print ISSN.
  • Electronic ISSN.
  • DOI, if available.
  • Screenshot with personal information hidden.
  • Expected result and actual result.

Incorrect Classification Reports

For incorrect or missing journal classifications, use the dedicated classification report email template.
